literal: Difficult actions they say exist-do? with instruments time having known if one does.
translation: Are there any actions said to be impossible? Not if one acts with the right instruments and knows the right time.
modern: தகுந்த கருவிகளுடன் ஏற்ற காலத்தை அறிந்து ஒரு செயலைச் செய்தால், செய்வதற்கு அரிய செயல் என்று சொல்லப்படுவது எதுவும் இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the importance of combining the right tools with the right timing. The word 'கருவியான்' refers to the necessary instruments or means, while 'காலம்' refers to the appropriate moment. When an action is performed with both, even tasks considered impossible ('அருவினை') become achievable. The rhetorical question 'உளவோ' implies that no such impossible tasks exist under these conditions.
